name: Star Salvager: Frontier
description: A 3D spacecraft exploration and mining adventure. Explore four richly rendered planets, harvest resources, outfly raider patrols, return to your orbital station and expand your ship through branching upgrades.
controls: W/S pitch · A/D roll · Q/E yaw · R or Shift throttle up · F or Ctrl throttle down · Space EMP (unlock) · Tab ship terminal · V camera.
